answer_1.quote: Our experiments are broadly designed to answer the high-level question: can ConCoRD leverage the relational knowledge ... without additional data or fine-tuning? ... We evaluate ConCoRD on open-ended QA, VQA, and test-time model editing.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to questions (textual QA and VQA responses)

answer_2.quote: We measure accuracy using binary F1 between elements ... and the truth value of facts ... We also report accuracy as the proportion of questions answered correctly ... and perfect consistency as the proportion of question groups that were perfectly consistent.
